name: sri-sankara-production
description: Sri Sankara TV — Enterprise Production Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w @sankara/backend" "npm run dev -w @sankara/frontend" "npm run dev -w @sankara/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sankara/shared && npm run build -w @sankara/frontend && npm run build -w @sankara/admin
scripts.test:all: npm run test -w @sankara/backend && npm run test -w @sankara/frontend
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['node_modules', 'apps/frontend/node_modules', 'apps/admin/node_modules', 'apps/backend/node_modules', 'packages/shared/node_modules', 'packages/constants/node_modules', 'packages/ui/node_modules', 'packages/config/node_modules'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }));"

author: Sri Sankara TV Engineering Team
